product_family: Legal-Grade AI for contract automation, negotiation, analysis, compliance, investigation, and collaboration. Serves legal, compliance, procurement, finance, HR, sales, and marketing teams. Enterprise-focused with 1000+ customers across 70 countries.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Luminance is certified to ISO 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to maintaining an effective Information Security Management System.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Luminance has completed a successful SOC 2 Type 2 examination, which assesses controls related to security, availability, and confidentiality.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR is not a certification Luminance holds. However, they support GDPR compliance features and have Data Processing Agreements (DPA) available with Standard Contractual Clauses and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification found on Luminance's website or in available compliance documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Luminance permits use of anonymized and pseudonymized customer data for product improvement and service enhancement. The terms state: 'we may carry out analytics and other review and storage processes on your User Data using anonymisation, pseudonymisation and other similar techniques.' For generative AI features (Ask Lumi), third-party providers may be involved, and redaction may not always be possible. Personal data itself is not retained or used to train core models.
privacy.data_region: Cambridge, United Kingdom (primary storage); EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses for international transfers

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 bit encryption via AWS Key Management Services

security.name: Data storage
security.value: AWS-hosted with dedicated single-tenant instances per customer; nightly automated backups to secondary AWS data center (same region); 14-day minimum backup retention

security.name: Access control
security.value: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) required; application-level permissions configured by customers; role-based access using least privilege; all access tracked and audited

security.name: Threat detection
security.value: Darktrace Enterprise Immune System deployment; Juniper firewalls; rate-limiting against DoS/brute force attacks; regular third-party penetration testing; mandatory security training for personnel

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Data controller informed within 24 hours of breach awareness
